Gini

rows.label: top income share
rows.query: ("top income share" OR "top 1 percent" OR "income concentration") AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")

rows.label: wage/income dispersion
rows.query: ("wage dispersion" OR "income dispersion" OR "earnings inequality") AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")

rows.label: relative deprivation
rows.query: "relative deprivation" AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")

rows.label: status anxiety / positional externality
rows.query: ("status anxiety" OR "positional externality" OR "conspicuous consumption") AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")

rows.label: shadow education / private tutoring x inequality
rows.query: ("shadow education" OR "private tutoring" OR "cram school") AND ("inequality" OR "competition")

rows.label: enrichment / extracurricular spending x inequality
rows.query: ("enrichment expenditure" OR "extracurricular" OR "enrichment activities") AND ("inequality" OR "income distribution")

rows.label: parental spending responds to inequality
rows.query: ("parental spending" OR "parental investment" OR "educational spending") AND ("income inequality" OR "Gini" OR "top income share")

rows.label: distribution stat AND investment AND fertility
rows.query: ("Gini" OR "income inequality" OR "top income share") AND ("parental investment" OR "child investment" OR "educational spending" OR "private tutoring") AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")

rows.label: status/positional AND investment AND fertility
rows.query: ("status competition" OR "relative status" OR "social comparison" OR "positional") AND ("parental investment" OR "child investment" OR "educational spending") AND ("fertility" OR "childbearing" OR "birth rate" OR "total fertility rate" OR "family size" OR "number of children")
